author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Sixty One! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Bleding Deck-Building card game mechanics, STL Printing and Miniature Wargame arena combat, Malediction is a Dark Fantasy arena battle game where Seekers enter an extra-planar realm to battle each other for relics and mastery. Let's check it out!

Check out the rulebook for free in digital  HERE: https://malediction.gg/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Malediction-Rulebook-July-2025.pdf

Check out the Starter Sets HERE: https://shop.malediction.gg/products/two-player-starter-bundle?variant=51765231386926
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 061 - MALEDICTION by Loot Studios
